title: The Gate Is Not the Keep
short_role: Decide whether scarce recovery belongs to the Workshop support chain.
setup: The entrance still stands, but the Workshop has taken the support pressure. Repair it now, or keep the stores and accept the exposed dependency.

choices.label: Repair Workshop (8 materials, 1 action)
choices.visible_result: The Workshop regains thirty condition before the next mixed pressure.

choices.label: Keep the stores for the wall
choices.visible_result: Materials and recovery actions are preserved, but the Workshop remains exposed.
